name: bear-harness
description: Bear Harness — roleplay-first local companion desktop framework (npm workspaces monorepo).

scripts.lint: biome ci --diagnostic-level=error && node scripts/check-obsolete-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-release-baseline.mjs && node scripts/check-release-version.mjs && node scripts/check-release-workflow.mjs && npm run lint:knip && node scripts/check-tailwind-atomic-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-design-language.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-copy-ownership.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-controls.mjs && node scripts/check-renderer-push.mjs && node scripts/check-renderer-effects.mjs && node scripts/check-test-quality.mjs && node scripts/check-rpc-contracts.mjs && node scripts/check-data-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-web-dev-test-leaks.mjs && node scripts/check-role-tool-surface.mjs && node scripts/check-character-media.mjs && node scripts/check-canon-packages.mjs && node scripts/validate-workflow.mjs && npm run lint --workspace @bear-harness/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/product-config && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/i18n && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/schema && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/companion-client && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/host-runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/companion-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace @bear-harness/web-dev
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/check-renderer-effects.test.mjs scripts/check-ui-design-language.test.mjs scripts/release-evidence.test.mjs && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/i18n && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/protocol && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/host-runtime && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/companion-ui && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/desktop && npm run test:unit --workspace @bear-harness/web-dev
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @bear-harness/host-runtime && npm run test:coverage --workspace @bear-harness/companion-ui && npm run test:coverage --workspace @bear-harness/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bear-harness/desktop && npm run build --workspace @bear-harness/web-dev
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.check:electron: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:electron && npm run test:diagnostics:crash
